sections.heading: The cabinet that swallows everything.
sections.body:
Deep base cabinets stack pots two and three rows back, and the lids never live with the pans they belong to. So the back becomes storage you kneel on the floor to reach — or storage you forget you have.

We fit full-extension pull-outs cut to your exact opening, so the whole shelf clears the cabinet and the back row comes to you. Heavy-gauge glides carry cast iron and full stock pots without sagging, and a slotted rack or shallow upper shelf keeps the lids with their pans. Measured on site, built in our shop, installed in a single morning.

items.question: Will it fit my vanity cabinet?
items.answer: Almost always. Each pull-out is cut to your exact opening, including the face frame and any hinge intrusion.

items.question: How much weight will a shelf hold?
items.answer: Our standard glides are rated to **100 lb** per shelf, more than enough for towels, bottles and appliances.

items.question: Can you work around the plumbing?
items.answer: Yes. Where the trap runs through, we notch or U-cut the shelf so the space either side stays usable.

items.question: Do you have to remove the vanity doors?
items.answer: No. The pull-outs fit inside the vanity you already have. Doors and counters stay where they are.

items.question: How long does it take to install?
items.answer: A single vanity is fitted in well under a morning. We tell you the timing before you book.
